# Profiles and conformance units

<!-- Code generated by internal/cmd/profiles. DO NOT EDIT. -->

The Profiles of OPC 10000-7 this library targets, with the evidence in this
repository for each of their ConformanceUnits. The server lists a Profile in
its ServerProfileArray (OPC 10000-5 §6.3.2) only when every mandatory
ConformanceUnit of it and of the Profiles it includes is evidenced;
`server.WithServerProfiles` replaces the computed list. Nothing here is
certified by the OPC Foundation.

- Source: the Released Profiles of profile group UACore 1.05 of the
  [OPC Foundation profile database](https://profiles.opcfoundation.org/), exported on 2026-11-28 from
  `https://profiles.opcfoundation.org/api/profilegroup/export/xml/171?rs=3` (served as
  `ProfileSet_UACore_1.05_2026-11-28.xml`) and pinned in
  `internal/profiles/testdata/ProfileSet_UACore_1.05.xml`, SHA-256
  `6457fc7c4303ee0de64c7d2db3e75a212145aa132a2c268f1fb6054b6448e0a1`.
- Evidence: `internal/profiles/inventory.json`. Tests are `dir:TestName`, dir relative
  to the module root; ledger rows are `capability|direction` rows of
  `interop/coverage.json` verified against opcua-interop v0.20.0 (INTEROP.md).
- Status: **evidenced**, the library does what the unit requires and the
  tests assert it; **partial**, a part is implemented or tested, the note
  says what is missing; **missing**, not implemented or not tested.
- `make gen` writes this file and `server/server_profiles_gen.go`, and
  `make check-gen` fails on drift. `go test ./internal/profiles` fails when a
  test, ledger row or document of the inventory does not exist, or a
  ConformanceUnit of a target has no entry.

## Micro Embedded Device 2025 Server Profile

URI `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Server/MicroEmbeddedDevice2025`, role server. It includes:

- Nano Embedded Device 2025 Server Profile, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Server/NanoEmbeddedDevice2025`
- Core 2022 Server Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Server/Core2022Facet`
- Security Time Synchronization, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Security/TimeSync`
- UA-TCP UA-SC UA-Binary, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Transport/uatcp-uasc-uabinary`
- Embedded DataChange Subscription 2022 Server Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Server/EmbeddedDataChangeSubscription2022`

Mandatory ConformanceUnits not evidenced:

- Base Info SemanticChange Bit (partial): The SemanticsChanged bit is set after a Property with the SemanticChange AccessLevel changes by a Write or Node.SetAttribute; a change by a SetValueFunc or another data source is not seen (LIMITATIONS.md).
- Security Default ApplicationInstance Certificate (partial): The library creates no default ApplicationInstanceCertificate: docs/security.md tells how to make one, for testing, and without one only SecurityPolicy None can be served, by explicit opt-in.
- Session Multiple (partial): Many Sessions at once (100 by default), but one dispatcher serves the requests of all of them in turn (server/server.go): a slow Method or value function holds up every Session; only ValueWriter Writes and waiting Publish requests leave it.

## Standard UA Client 2025 Profile

URI `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/Standard2025`, role client. It includes:

- Base Client Behaviour Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/Behaviour`
- Global Discovery Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/GlobalDiscovery`
- AddressSpace Lookup Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/AddressSpaceLookup`
- Method Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/Method`
- Entry Level Support 2015 Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/EntryLevelSupport2015`
- Subnet Discovery Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/SubnetDiscovery`
- User Token – User Name Password Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Security/UserToken/Client/UserNamePassword`
- Discovery Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/Discovery`
- DataChange Subscriber 2022 Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/DataChangeSubscriber2022`
- Minimum UA 2025 Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/MinimumFacet2025`
- Core 2022 Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/Core2022`
- Security Time Synchronization, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Security/TimeSync`
- SecurityPolicy – None, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA/SecurityPolicy#None`
- User Token – Anonymous Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Security/UserToken/Client/Anonymous`
- UA-TCP UA-SC UA-Binary, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Transport/uatcp-uasc-uabinary`
- Global Certificate Management Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/GlobalCertificateManagement`
- Attribute Write Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/AttributeWrite`
- Attribute Read Client Facet, `http://opcfoundation.org/UA-Profile/Client/AttributeRead`

Mandatory ConformanceUnits not evidenced:

- Address Space Client Base (partial): NodeClasses, Attributes and References are used and tested; no test shows that String NodeIds and BrowseNames that differ only in case are kept apart.
- Base Info Client Honour Operation Limits (partial): The client does not read the OperationLimits: ReadMulti splits at a fixed or given size, and Read, Write, Browse and Call are not split.
- Base Info Client Type Pre-Knowledge (partial): Namespace 0 types are compiled in and need no type nodes, but no test runs against a server that exposes no types.
- Discovery Client Find Servers Dynamic (missing): The client does not detect new Servers after a first FindServers call; the application calls it again.
- Discovery Client Get Endpoints Dynamic (partial): The client fetches the Endpoints again only on reconnect after Bad_CertificateInvalid; it does not detect other changes.
- Documentation - Core Capacities (missing): No document gives the capacities of the client (SecureChannels, Sessions, continuation points, Subscriptions, Publish requests, MonitoredItems).
- Pull Model for Global Certificate and TrustList Management (partial): gds.PullClient covers the Part 12 pull Methods, but the client applies only the trusted certificates it pulls and checks no pulled revocation list; no coverage.json row.
- Security Administration (partial): Token, policy, mode, None by opt-in and trusted CAs are options; an unknown certificate is always refused, and accepting any valid certificate exists only as InsecureSkipVerify, which skips every check.
- Security Default ApplicationInstance Certificate (partial): The library creates no default ApplicationInstanceCertificate; docs/security.md tells how to make one, for testing.
- Security Policy Required (partial): Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep and Basic256Sha256 are supported, but the obsolete Basic128Rsa15 and Basic256 are usable without administrative intervention, which the unit forbids.
- SecurtyPolicy_None_Limits (partial): SecurityPolicy None derives no keys (uapolicy/policyNone.go), but no test asserts a DerivedSignatureKeyLength of 0.
- Subscription Client Basic (partial): Intervals, lifetime and keep-alive are set and Notifications acknowledged, but the client keeps one Publish request outstanding whatever the number of Subscriptions, not a sufficient number.
- Subscription Client Fallback (partial): Subscriptions are optional and the keep-alive uses Read, but nothing falls back to Read when CreateSubscription fails, and no test runs against a server without Subscriptions.
- Subscription Client Republish (partial): Missing Notifications are republished after a reconnect; a sequence number gap in a live Session is only logged (client_sub.go).
- Time Sync - Support (missing): No document names a time synchronization mechanism, as the unit requires.
